TABLE II. Parameters of the femtosecond laser.

| Parameter                        | Value           |
|----------------------------------|-----------------|
| Average power P                  | 10W             |
| Repetition frequency f rep       | 100/200/400 kHz |
| Pulse width τ p                  | 400 fs          |
| Maximum single pulse energy E sp | 50 μ J          |
| Wavelength λ                     | 1030nm          |
| Beam quality factor M 2          | <1.3            |
